# FG-REPO-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_reserved_or_taken_or_tombstoned_username_is_rejected` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この名前はすでに使われています。別の名前を指定してください。
- en: This name is already in use. Choose another name.
- id: Nama ini sudah digunakan. Pilih nama lain.

## 原因 (cause)

The path is used by a sibling (user, group or project under the same parent) or blocked by a tombstone of a renamed, moved or deleted namespace (ADR-0015); a tombstone blocks the path until it is released.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`: `sibling` (a namespace with this path exists) or `tombstoned` (forge.namespace_tombstones has the path; the audit log has the rename, transfer or delete that wrote it). Showing which of the two is an accepted exposure (ADR-0015). A `sibling` right after a create that failed with FG-DB-0002 `reason=commit_outcome_unknown` usually means the first attempt did commit: look the path up in forge.namespaces and the audit log (`user.created`, `group.created` or `project.created` with the same request_id) before treating it as a conflict.

## 対処 (fix)

Choose another name, or have the tombstone released by the current owner of its target (or an administrator) when the old path is meant to be reused.
